name: Disarming Voice
description: You let out a charming cry, dealing emotional damage to any creature in range that can hear you. This move automatically hits for {dice} {type} damage unless a creature is in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig, Bounce, etc.
optional: Instead of automatically hitting, targets make a CHA save against your MOVE DC. On failure, they take full damage and have disadvantage on their next attack. On success, they take half damage.
